name: Burin
description: Burin lines: eight clean furrows cut across a solid ground.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*8 { x: calc(@nx(-1) * 12.5); y: -1; width: 7; height: 102; fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*8 { x: calc(@nx(-1) * 12.5); y: -1; width: 7; height: 102; fill: #000 }); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
